name: Lincoln County, SD
findings: Lincoln County has 199 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lincoln County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lincoln County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 90 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
